purpose: Complete the legacy V5 runner implementation migration for the remaining M1_MID economic shard without changing scientific rules.

independent.requirement: Must be frozen in GitHub and readback-SHA verified before execution; must not call candidate outcome or selection functions; may independently rebuild the same signal masks and use the exact verified executable-minute summaries only as a lossless acceleration index into raw ticks.

ledger_hash_definition: For each selected trade in chronological order: entry_ts int64 little-endian bytes + exit_ts int64 little-endian bytes + R float64 native little-endian bytes; SHA-256 over concatenation.

required: candidate and independent signal-hash+side keysets exactly equal
648 of 648 ordered selected-trade ledger SHA-256 values exactly equal
0 net-R byte/value mismatches beyond exact float64 equality
candidate signal identity remains equal to the preregistered M1_MID signal identity
no partial or timeout output promoted
parity_gate.pass_condition: All 648 side-ledgers exact with zero mismatches and all source/input identities verified.
parity_gate.fail_condition: Any source hash, signal identity, keyset, trade sequence, R value, count, or ledger hash mismatch fails closed. No tuning against M1_MID economic performance is permitted.

promotion_rule: Parity PASS only authorizes promotion of M1_MID as the 12th DEV economic shard and subsequent 12_of_12 audit. It does not constitute Gate A, holdout, Supergate, or strategy approval.
